patch_description: Structural redesign around a two-phase optimizer pipeline: a precomputed triplet index array drives fully vectorized area computation; Phase 1 uses a log-sum-exp soft-min objective over the smallest ~15% of triangles for landscape smoothing, Phase 2 switches to the hard minimum with a minimal-triangle-first move ordering. A barycentric projection operator guarantees feasibility after every move. Multiple deterministic seeds (lattice + seeded random starts) are funneled through the same pipeline, with the best result cached at module load. This combines the smoothing benefit with a hard-min polish while keeping everything vectorized and deterministic.
